# PHPMailer

Unmodified runtime files from PHPMailer v7.1.1 (LGPL 2.1).
Source: https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/tree/v7.1.1
Only Exception.php, PHPMailer.php and SMTP.php are needed for SMTP/mail delivery.
Keep LICENSE and this version pin when updating. No Composer runtime is required.
